observations: Line 1 declares `bucket=[]` as a default argument, which is evaluated once at function definition time rather than per call.
Lines 2-3 append to and return the same default list object, so repeated omitted-bucket calls share and mutate one list.
The stated behavior contract ('Each omitted-bucket call gets a fresh bucket') is not satisfied by lines 1-3 as written.
Probe p1 (collect(1) then collect(2) with omitted bucket) would observe the second snapshot containing both 1 and 2, not a fresh bucket.
Probe p2 (collect(3, [9])) passes an explicit list, so line 2 mutates that caller-owned list in place and line 3 returns it, matching the explicit-bucket half of the contract.
No exception handling or input validation appears on lines 1-3; any object lacking `.append` would raise at line 2.
